Use `OUTCOME_NONE_UNSUPPORTED` when impossible in-environment, or `OUTCOME_NONE_CLARIFICATION` when intent may allow an alternative artifact but acceptance criteria are ambiguous.

Treat post-write cosmetic reindent/reflow edits as disallowed in focused-diff workflows. Verification should be read-only and should not trigger formatting rewrites.
